import json

result = read_file(path='~/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p12-json-top-customer/orders_export.json')
data = json.loads(result)

# Calculate total spent per customer for shipped orders
customer_totals = {}

for order in data['orders']:
    if order['status'] == 'shipped':
        customer = order['customer']
        name = f"{customer['first']} {customer['last']}"
        order_total = sum(item['qty'] * item['unit_price'] for item in order['items'])
        customer_totals[name] = customer_totals.get(name, 0) + order_total

# Find the customer with the highest total
top_customer = max(customer_totals, key=customer_totals.get)
print(f"Customer totals: {customer_totals}")
print(f"Top customer: {top_customer} with total: {customer_totals[top_customer]}")
